provenance: Opus 5.5 subscription CLI draft with host review/repairs, source restrictions and execution verification.

draft_notes.limitations: The output size is fixed at 2x2, matching the constructor. It is not derived from the grid (the archived solver used size//5). The program assumes the two frames have distinct colours that differ from the background, as random_colors provides. If two same-coloured frames touched, they would merge into one component. The archived solver's hole-area key would contradict the generator on some fresh scenes, so it was not used as the primary key. The approved fixtures are consistent with the bbox-area rule.
